page.title: Extension Sets Manager
page.t: Save named sets of enabled and disabled extensions and switch between them.
Manage extensions as named sets. While this is on, extension states can only be changed by editing a set.
Managed by Extension Sets. Press Edit on a set to change extension states.
The Default set shares the common savegames and cannot keep its own.
Open the settings of this extension.
How much this extension writes to the game log. Use Debug or Trace only when troubleshooting.
No sets saved yet. Capture your current setup to create the first one.
Set %s applied. Restart the game for the change to take effect.
This manager and the extensions it needs are always kept enabled.
Set %s captured from the current setup.
Extension changes are already pending a restart.
Savegames of this set are kept apart, under the id %s.
Delete the set %s? The extensions themselves are not changed.
With this on the set keeps its own savegames, under the id %s; with it off it shares the common ones.
Delete this set's own savegames together with the set.
This set has no savegames of its own.
Delete the set %s and its own savegames? The extensions themselves are not changed.
This set shares the common savegames.
No more sets can be created: set ids stop at %s.
Set %s no longer keeps its own savegames. What should happen to the ones it already has?
%s extension(s) differ from the applied set %s. What should happen?
The set you are editing has not been saved yet. Save or cancel the edit before leaving the extension list.
